The Roubic Moreland Hills Story

Estate-Canopy Work Since 1982

Roubic has served Moreland Hills since 1982 — 44 years of continuous local presence from our Auburn Township yard just 6 miles away. Moreland Hills is one of five Tier 1 flagship markets, and the trees that make the village look the way it does — heritage red and white oaks, sugar maples, American beech, and EAB-risk ash — are exactly the trees we work on.

The estate-district context matters: Moreland Hills homeowners maintain mature 60–100+ year canopy on 1–3+ acre lots, and the village's tree-preservation ordinance rewards proactive, dormant-season pruning. That's a fit with how Roubic operates — owner-supervised jobs, ANSI A300 pruning standards, and a full owned equipment fleet including crane support for the largest specimens.

Moreland Hills homeowners want to know the person walking their property. That's the whole reason I still walk every estimate — 40-plus years later. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Common Moreland Hills Questions

Moreland Hills Tree Service FAQ

Six things Moreland Hills homeowners want to know before booking.

Do you serve Moreland Hills, OH?
Yes — Moreland Hills is part of Roubic's Tier 1 flagship service area, about 6 miles from our Auburn Township yard, and we've served the village since 1982. Call {{global.phone}} for a free on-site estimate.
How quickly can Roubic respond in Moreland Hills?
Tier 1 markets like Moreland Hills receive priority estimate scheduling during business hours (Mon–Fri 7am–6pm) and next-day scheduling at the latest. For after-hours storm and emergency calls, our 24/7 line dispatches crews with a target of on-site within 2–4 hours inside the primary service area.
Do I need a tree-removal permit in Moreland Hills?
Yes — Moreland Hills has a tree-preservation ordinance that requires a village permit for healthy-tree removal above a specified DBH threshold; hazard trees (dead or dying) follow an expedited process. Roubic coordinates the permit workflow with Village Hall as part of the job, and any permit fees are disclosed upfront in your quote.
How much does tree removal cost in Moreland Hills?
Tree removal in Moreland Hills typically runs $200–$10,000+ depending on size, species, access, and permit fees. Small trees under 20 ft start around $200–$500; mature 50–80 ft trees run $1,500–$3,500; very large heritage estate trees requiring crane assistance can exceed $10,000. Every estimate is free and confirmed on-site before you book.
What tree services are available in Moreland Hills?
Roubic offers Tree Removal, Tree Trimming & Pruning, Stump Grinding, Land Clearing, Storm Damage & Emergency Tree Care, and Firewood Delivery in Moreland Hills. Click into any service card above for full pricing, process, and FAQ details.
Do you handle EAB ash removal and oak work safely?
Yes — EAB-killed ash removal is ongoing across the village, and dead ash becomes brittle fast, so we prioritize it before it fails. For oaks, we observe the oak-wilt calendar and avoid oak pruning April 1 through July 31, working to ANSI A300 standards year-round with a full owned equipment fleet including crane support.
